title: Single Texture Blocks
description: A mod that takes a random texture file from Minecraft and makes a block with only that texture.
body:
![Singletextureblocs logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/00c848f815e1f019406f70e3d8ebd4c94cc9ddac.png)

Made with MCreator

a mod that takes a random texture file from minecraft and made a block with only that texture.

This mod is made for making building easier and... more funny !

/!\: This mod is **only** for NeoForge™. Only for 1.21.8 or newer versions of Minecraft

if you found a missing block (propably by looking in the mod files) please tell Me by [clicking here](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSde1jDniF2rZkioFSrl1jjS8UGtZR215di6zMnc60HHoF7bgw/viewform?usp=preview)

if you want, visit the [official website](https://sites.google.com/view/singletextureblocks/accueil)
